title: Two stronger directions — same posting flow
question: Compare the actual mockups: Dispatch uses a compact text-first workspace and a destination status rail; Margin uses an open writing surface and an annotation gutter. Both retain Choose → write → review and the same manual Instagram finish. Which should carry forward?

options.label: A · Dispatch
options.thesis: A compact charcoal workspace with clear destination rows and warm amber actions.
options.viewport: A compact stage line above a text-first shared editor; the three destination versions read as aligned status rows.
options.risk: The denser, darker direction feels more like a utility; a complementary light theme would still be needed.

options.label: B · Margin
options.thesis: An open writing surface with readable serif post text, generous media, and a useful annotation gutter.
options.viewport: A shared post reads like writing, with its photos and platform-specific notes aligned to an annotation gutter.
options.risk: The reading-oriented treatment uses more vertical space and feels less like a conventional social composer.
